lazard-lcoeplus-2025.title: Levelized Cost of Energy+ (LCOE+), version 18.0
lazard-lcoeplus-2025.note: Unsubsidized LCOE ranges for new US plants, US$/MWh: utility PV 38–78, community & C&I PV 81–217, onshore wind 37–86, offshore wind 70–157, geothermal 66–109, gas combined cycle 48–109, coal 71–173, US nuclear 141–220, gas peaking 149–251.
